selected_tool.instructions: Which of these tools best serves the `user_request`?

criteria.currentWeather: Returns the current temperature and conditions for a named place
criteria.sendEmail: Sends an email message to one or more recipients
criteria.createInvoice: Creates and issues an invoice for a customer
criteria.searchOrders: Finds past orders belonging to a customer
criteria.bookMeeting: Schedules a meeting in the calendar with a set of attendees

any_tool_applies.instructions: Does any tool listed in `available_tools` do what the `user_request` needs?

criteria.true: A listed tool performs the requested action
criteria.false: The user can be answered without one of these tools
